items.html: It thus follows that the Mochin of Gadlut are divided into four Mochin, which are Hochma, Bina, Hesed, and Gevura. But the Mochin of nursing are only three, namely Hochma, Bina, and Gevura. And this is the difference that there is also between the time of nursing and the time of Gadlut, for the Daat of the time of nursing is only recognizable in him in an inclusive manner alone, as mentioned.
